planets.name: K2-129 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-129 with a 8.24-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-129 b was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-129. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
